priority: P0 Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s

source.base_subject: bench: reject Decode LM-head RP2 schedule
source.feature_subject: bench: validate fixed-position Decode CUDA Graph

current_stage_target.reason: P1 validates one fixed position and is not installed in generation or benchmark production dispatch.

candidate.name: fixed-position full predicted-only Decode CUDA Graph P1
candidate.capture_contract: Capture and instantiate the existing full Decode enqueue sequence without executing, synchronizing, analyzing host logits, or committing request state.
candidate.replay_contract: Update the unique embedding root for the current token, launch one GraphExec, then retain the existing stream synchronize, host greedy validation, and request-state commit boundary.
candidate.dynamic_input: cudaGraphExecKernelNodeSetParams updates token_id * 5120 on the embedding root before every replay.
candidate.fixed_inputs: position-dependent KV addresses, RoPE position, and attention sequence length remain specialized to position 19.

execution_model.interpretation: The graph amortizes host submission of the same serial kernel DAG; it does not create kernel overlap or buffering.

correctness_gate.oracle_prompt: 用一句话解释 CUDA 是什么。
correctness_gate.comparison: Every byte of the complete serial-result and graph-result request arenas is compared after restoring the same synchronized baseline.
correctness_gate.fail_fast: Any pinned prediction or complete-arena mismatch stops before warmup and timing.

harness_race_audit.initial_symptom: The primary path was exact but alternate Graph replay returned stale greedy index 77517 instead of serial 52965.
harness_race_audit.root_cause: Arena D2D restore used the default stream while the runner uses a nonblocking stream. D2D cudaMemcpy has no host completion guarantee, so Graph replay could race the restore and expose the baseline greedy workspace value.
harness_race_audit.fix: Synchronize after baseline snapshot, serial snapshot, and every restore. All synchronization is outside the measured step interval.
harness_race_audit.post_fix_result: Both token paths and both complete arenas are exact.

benchmark_protocol.sample_scope: One full predicted-only step including token validation, serial launches or Graph parameter update and launch, D2H, stream synchronize, host greedy validation, and commit.

unbound_environmental_warning.outlier: The second Graph sample in round 4 was 111.131213 ms while the other nine Graph samples were 105.718394-106.080254 ms.

environment.clock_scope: The selected final process uses the project's fixed-frequency MAXN environment. This record does not establish thermal-soak, power, energy, or cross-device behavior.

decision.p1: select fixed-position CUDA Graph launch amortization as a proven mechanism and preserve the strict test-only screen
decision.production: do not change the formal production anchor or claim the 100-ms target
decision.next: implement a position-specialized short-Decode GraphExec cache, first covering the real P19-P43 generation path with continuous state rather than snapshotting each token
p2_hard_gates: all 25 continuous predictions, final text/stop, and complete request arena exact
full-statistics, trace, reference backend, and cache-miss serial fallbacks exact
five of five paired hot-cache rounds improve
cache preparation at most 1 second and device-memory increase at most 256 MiB
decision.stop_loss: If correctness, hot performance, cold preparation, or memory gates fail, do not install the cache in production; evaluate a narrower position window or device-side dynamic-parameter control.

limitations: The achieved 105.747733-ms result is one fixed P19 replay, not a 25-token production generation result.
The formal 106.763000-ms/token production anchor remains authoritative until a multi-position generation promotion passes.
One GraphExec's cold capture/instantiate time and graph metadata memory were not measured in P1 and are mandatory P2 outputs.
The Graph preserves one-stream serial kernel execution; it is not double buffering, triple buffering, or Prefill/Decode overlap.
